Subject: Reminder: Punctuality for Client Meetings

Hi [Name],

I wanted to touch base regarding our recent client meetings. As you know, punctuality is a key part of how we present our professionalism to our clients, and I’ve noticed a few instances where we’ve started late.

To ensure we maintain our strong reputation, please make sure to arrive on time for all future engagements. Consistent lateness can impact our standing with clients, so I’d appreciate your help in keeping our schedule tight.

On a lighter note, while we’re waiting for the rain to come from the fluffy things in the sky, let’s make sure we’re ready to go the moment it stops!

Thanks for your attention to this.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
